title: Observer zone panels retain stale cards when a zone empties
description: In `ObserverGamePanel`, `distributeGraveyards` and `distributeExile` only call `loadCards` when the player zone is non-empty. If a graveyard or exile zone shrinks to zero cards after previously showing cards, the corresponding observer panel never receives the empty `CardsView`, so the old cards remain rendered. The panel implementations already know how to remove missing cards when they are given the authoritative zone contents; the bug is that the empty-zone update is skipped entirely.
